intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个共同信号：开源正在从「造模型」转向「管住模型的运行成本与使用边界」。无论是推理框架、模型路由网关，还是把语音、代理、部署收进本地自托管，重点都落在可控、可审计、不按调用量付费。对创业者来说，机会不在再做一个更强的模型，而在帮别人把已有的模型和工具用得省、用得稳、用得合规。
intro.en: Today's projects share one signal: open source is shifting from building models to governing how they run and what they cost. Inference frameworks, model routers, and local-first voice or agent tooling all push toward control, auditability, and escaping per-call pricing.

zh.summary: 开箱即用的桌面 AI 代理，把 Claude Code、Codex 等多个执行框架和模型混在一起，在本地真实文件和已登录应用上干活，任务中途可切换模型而记忆和技能保持连续。解决的是代理工具配置门槛高、只能绑定单一框架的问题。
zh.insight: 机会在「代理编排」而非再做一个代理：面向非工程岗位做预设工作流，比如把同一任务分给不同模型并行执行再交叉复核，卖的是可靠性和结果，不是工具本身。

en.summary: An out-of-the-box desktop agent that mixes Claude Code, Codex, and other harnesses and models, working on real local files and logged-in apps,
en.insight: The opening is orchestration, not another agent: package preset workflows for non-engineering roles,

items.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。

zh.summary: DeepSeek 把支撑自身大规模生产服务的推理框架开源，包含优化内核、MoE 专家并行、异步调度和确定性采样。它解决的是自建推理时吞吐和成本压不下来的问题，也是观察头部团队如何把模型跑便宜的实物样本。
zh.insight: 适合做私有化推理服务或 GPU 托管的人：把它当作性能基线，切入对确定性和批处理一致性有硬要求的场景，比如批量评测和合规审计，而不是通用聊天。

en.summary: DeepSeek open-sourced the inference framework behind its own production serving, with optimized kernels, MoE expert parallelism, async scheduling, and deterministic sampling.
en.insight: For private inference hosting or GPU resellers: treat it as a performance baseline and target workloads that need determinism and batch invariance,

items.description: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 一个零加价的模型网关，把托管、自带密钥和本地模型统一到一个 OpenAI 兼容接口下，并按用户和代理控制可用模型与预算，还能用生产流量训练自己的路由。解决的是多模型混用时成本失控和权限混乱。
zh.insight: 切企业内部 AI 平台的入口：先做「谁能用哪个模型、花多少钱」的配额与审计层，再靠积累的调用数据做路由优化，这比直接卖模型调用更有粘性。

en.summary: A zero-markup model gateway that puts hosted, bring-your-own-key, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible API, with per-user and per-agent model and budget controls,
en.insight: Enter as the internal AI platform layer: start with quota and audit for who uses which model and at what spend,

items.description: Experiential is the open source, zero markup gateway for BYOK, self-hosted and 1000+ marketplace models. It learns from your traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized model you own.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 把模型运行和微调做成桌面应用，支持 GGUF、MLX 以及多个主流开源模型系列，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它把原本要写脚本的微调流程变成本地图形操作，降低了个人和小团队训练定制模型的门槛。
zh.insight: 面向垂直行业做「数据到可用小模型」的交付服务：客户提供领域语料，你用这类桌面工具在本地完成微调并交付可运行模型，避开云训练成本和数据外流顾虑。

en.summary: Turns running and fine-tuning models into a desktop app supporting GGUF, MLX, and several major open model families across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.insight: Offer vertical delivery from data to a usable small model: clients supply domain corpora, you fine-tune locally with such desktop tooling and hand over a…

items.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4.1, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 在真实远端前放一个本地 git 代理，推送到它而不是 origin，它会开临时工作区跑 AI 校验流水线，全部通过才转发分支并自动开 PR。解决的是 AI 生成代码大量涌入后评审质量下滑的问题。
zh.insight: 适合团队内部的代码质量门禁：把校验规则做成可配置的策略包，按语言和仓库类型分发，切入对合规和审计有要求的工程组织，而不是个人开发者。

en.summary: A local git proxy sits in front of your real remote: push to it instead of origin, and it spins up a disposable worktree, runs an AI validation pipeline,
en.insight: Fits internal code-quality gates: turn validation rules into configurable policy packs distributed by language and repo type,

zh.summary: tokio 团队推出的 Rust 全栈 Web 框架，主打开箱即用，试图补齐 Rust 做 Web 应用时缺的默认约定。它值得看是因为 Rust 后端生态长期缺少类似 Rails 的一体化选择。
zh.insight: 更适合作为趋势信号：Rust 正在向应用层下沉。若做开发者工具，可围绕它的模板、认证和部署缺环做配套，而不是自己再造一个框架。

en.summary: A full-stack Rust web framework from the tokio team, pitched as batteries-included, trying to fill Rust's missing defaults for building web apps.
en.insight: Better read as a trend signal: Rust is moving down into application layers. If you build dev tools, target the gaps around its templating, auth,

items.description: A batteries-included framework for building web apps

zh.summary: 面向 Mac 的免费开源 Chromium 浏览器，把 Arc 的侧边栏和 Dia 的精致感结合起来，支持地址栏入侧栏、分屏和视频浮窗，默认拦截广告和追踪。它回应的是用户对主流浏览器改版和隐私策略的不满。
zh.insight: 浏览器本身难变现，但可借它的交互范式做垂直场景：比如把侧栏分屏做成面向研究或客服的多页面工作台，或为特定 SaaS 做内置侧边面板。

en.summary: A free, open-source Chromium browser for Mac blending Arc's sidebar with Dia's polish: address bar in the sidebar, split panes, floating video,
en.insight: The browser itself is hard to monetize, but borrow its interaction model for vertical use: turn the sidebar and split panes into a multi-page workbench for…

items.description: A free Chromium browser for the Mac: Arc's sidebar, Dia's polish. Chat on Discord: discord.gg/TdhuXrbcA6

zh.summary: 可自托管的 PaaS，用一条 SSH 连接就能在自己的服务器上部署静态站、数据库和数百个一键服务，配置留在自己机器上。它回应的是云平台账单上涨和数据主权诉求。
zh.insight: 不要重做部署面板，而是围绕它做托管运维服务或迁移工具：帮中小团队从 Vercel、Heroku 搬回自有服务器，按服务器数量收费，卖的是省心和迁移确定性。

en.summary: A self-hostable PaaS that deploys static sites, databases, and hundreds of one-click services on your own servers over a single SSH connection, keeping config on your hardware.
en.insight: Don't rebuild the deploy panel; build managed ops or migration tooling around it. Help small teams move off Vercel and Heroku onto their own servers,

items.description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 360+ one-click services on your own servers.

zh.summary: 完全本地的 ElevenLabs 替代品，覆盖声音克隆、配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持数百种语言，可跑在自己的硬件上。它回应的是内容创作者和机构对语音数据不出本地的需求。
zh.insight: 面向有声书、课程本地化和短视频配音团队做交付，而不是做通用语音 API。差异点在于素材和成品都留在客户机器上，适合对版权和隐私敏感的出版与教育客户。

en.summary: A fully local ElevenLabs alternative covering voice cloning, dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook production across hundreds of languages,
en.insight: Sell delivery to audiobook, course localization, and short-video dubbing teams rather than a generic voice API.

items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

zh.summary: 自托管的家庭规划器，把任务、日历、预算、餐食、购物和健康等二十多个模块装进一个 PWA，跑在自家服务器或 NAS 上，单个 SQLite 文件、无追踪。它针对的是一家人被十几个订阅制应用割裂的日常。
zh.insight: 适合做面向家庭的自托管套件或区域化部署服务：切入德语区等对数据隐私敏感的市场，卖安装、备份和升级托管，而不是卖软件许可。

en.summary: A self-hosted family planner bundling tasks, calendar, budget, meals, shopping, and health across 20-plus modules in one PWA on your own server or NAS,
en.insight: Good for a self-hosted family suite or regional deployment service: target privacy-sensitive markets like German-speaking Europe and sell install, backup,

items.description: One home instead of many subscriptions. Yuvomi is a self-hosted family planner: tasks, calendar, budget, meals, shopping, health and more in one PWA on your own server or NAS. Docker, Podman, TrueNAS, Umbrel, Unraid. No tracking, MIT.
